title: outstanding spawned work is cancelled and cleaned at root shutdown
purpose: The async root owns eagerly spawned futures and awaits their cleanup.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: async guide 6.4: when the root finishes, unfinished owned work receives a cancellation request and the runtime waits for its cleanup (defer runs); expected Cancelled is not reported as an error.
